meta.title: Help Center | Arnesh Dive
meta.description: Frequently asked questions about purchases, shipping, and products at Arnesh Dive.

header.title: Help Center
header.description: Find answers to frequently asked questions or contact us if you need further assistance.

0.question: How long does shipping take?
0.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days, while express shipping takes 1-2 business days. Shipping time is calculated from when the order leaves our warehouse.

1.question: How can I track my order?
1.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number and a link to track your shipment. You can also check the status on the "My Orders" page in your account.

2.question: Can I change my shipping address after checkout?
2.answer: Address changes can only be made before the order is processed. Please contact our customer service as soon as possible via WhatsApp or email.

3.question: Which couriers are available?
3.answer: We work with JNE, J&T Express, SiCepat, ID Express, AnterAja, POS Indonesia, and Tiki. Courier availability may vary by location.

0.question: How do I return a product?
0.answer: Contact our customer service within 7 days of receiving your order. Include photos of the product and the reason for the return. Once approved, you'll receive instructions for shipping the item back.

1.question: Is there a return fee?
1.answer: Return shipping is covered by the buyer unless the product is defective or doesn't match the order. We cover reshipping costs for exchanges.

2.question: How long does the refund process take?
2.answer: Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days after we receive and inspect the product. The time it takes to reach your account depends on your payment method and bank.

3.question: Which products can't be returned?
3.answer: Used products, custom/special-color products, and products with a broken seal cannot be returned. Masks also cannot be returned for hygiene reasons.

0.question: What payment methods are available?
0.answer: We accept bank transfer (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI), credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard), e-wallets (GoPay, OVO, Dana), and QRIS.

1.question: Is my payment secure?
1.answer: Yes, all transactions are encrypted with SSL/TLS protocols. We don't store your credit card details. Payment processing is handled by a trusted payment gateway.

2.question: What if my payment fails?
2.answer: Check your card balance or limit. If the problem continues, try another payment method or contact your bank. Your cart is saved for 24 hours.

3.question: Can I pay in installments?
3.answer: Yes, we offer installments without a credit card through our partner. The installment option appears at checkout for purchases of at least Rp 500,000.

0.question: How do I choose the right size?
0.answer: Every product comes with a size guide. You can also contact customer service for recommendations based on your height and weight.

1.question: Are the products guaranteed 100% original?
1.answer: Yes, all products we sell are 100% original from authorized distributors. We guarantee authenticity for every product.

2.question: How do I take care of diving equipment?
2.answer: Rinse with fresh water after use, dry in a shaded area (avoid direct sunlight), and store in a dry place. Care details vary by product, check the label or product guide.

3.question: Is there a warranty?
3.answer: Warranty follows each brand's own policy, usually 6-12 months for factory defects. Keep your invoice as proof of purchase.

0.question: How do I edit my profile?
0.answer: Log in to your account and go to the "Profile" or "Settings" page. You can change your name, email, phone number, and address.

1.question: I forgot my password, how do I reset it?
1.answer: Click "Forgot Password" on the login page. Enter your registered email and you'll receive a link to reset your password.

2.question: Do I have to create an account to shop?
2.answer: Yes, an account is required to track orders, save addresses, and earn reward points. Registration is quick and free.

3.question: How do I delete my account?
3.answer: Contact our customer service via email or WhatsApp with your account deletion request. Your data will be deleted within 30 business days in accordance with our privacy policy.
